title: Modulatory effects of rutin and vitamin A on hyperglycemia induced glycation, oxidative stress and inflammation in high-fat-fructose diet animal model.
authors: Iqbal, Aqsa; Hafeez Kamran, Sairah; Siddique, Farhan; Ishtiaq, Saiqa; Hameed, Misbah; Manzoor, Mobina
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芦丁和维生素A对高糖诱导糖化、氧化应激和炎症的调节作用，仅含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: In the current study we investigated the impact of combination of rutin and vitamin A on glycated products, the glyoxalase system, oxidative markers, and inflammation in animals fed a high-fat high-fructose (HFFD) diet. Thirty rats were randomly divided into six groups (n = 5). The treatments, metformin (120 mg/kg), rutin (100 mg/kg), vitamin A (43 IU/kg), and a combination of rutin (100 mg/kg) and vitamin A (43 IU/kg) were given to relevant groups of rats along with high-fructose high-fat diet for 42 days. HbA1c, D-lactate, Glyoxylase-1, Hexokinase 2, malondialdehyde (MDA), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), catalase (CAT), nuclear transcription factor-B (NF-kappaB), interleukin-6 (IL-6), interleukin-8 (IL-8) and histological examinations were performed after 42 days. The docking simulations were conducted using Auto Dock package. The combined effects of rutin and vitamin A in treated rats significantly (p < 0.001) reduced HbA1c, hexokinase 2, and D-lactate levels while preventing cellular damage. The combination dramatically (p < 0.001) decreased MDA, CAT, and GPx in treated rats and decreased the expression of inflammatory cytokines such as IL-6 andIL-8, as well as the transcription factor NF-kappaB. The molecular docking investigations revealed that rutin had a strong affinity for several important biomolecules, including as NF-kappaB, Catalase, MDA, IL-6, hexokinase 2, and GPx. The results propose beneficial impact of rutin and vitamin A as a convincing treatment strategy to treat AGE-related disorders, such as diabetes, autism, alzheimer's, atherosclerosis.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了芦丁与维生素A联合使用对高脂高果糖饮食（HFFD）喂养动物中糖化产物、乙二醛酶系统、氧化标志物及炎症的影响。三十只大鼠被随机分为六组（n=5）。治疗组分别给予二甲双胍（120 mg/kg）、芦丁（100 mg/kg）、维生素A（43 IU/kg）以及芦丁（100 mg/kg）和维生素A（43 IU/kg）的联合用药，同时配合高果糖高脂饮食，持续42天。42天后，检测了HbA1c、D-乳酸、乙二醛酶-1、己糖激酶2、丙二醛（MDA）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）、核转录因子-κB（NF-kappaB）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、白细胞介素-8（IL-8）并进行组织学检查。分子对接模拟使用Auto Dock软件包进行。在治疗大鼠中，芦丁和维生素A的联合作用显著（p < 0.001）降低了HbA1c、己糖激酶2和D-乳酸水平，同时防止了细胞损伤。该联合治疗显著（p < 0.001）降低了治疗大鼠中的MDA、CAT和GPx，并减少了炎症细胞因子如IL-6和IL-8以及转录因子NF-kappaB的表达。分子对接研究显示，芦丁对多种重要生物分子具有强亲和力，包括NF-kappaB、过氧化氢酶、MDA、IL-6、己糖激酶2和GPx。结果表明，芦丁和维生素A的联合使用作为一种有说服力的治疗策略，对治疗与AGE相关的疾病，如糖尿病、自闭症、阿尔茨海默病和动脉粥样硬化，具有有益效果。
